inputs.text: Phoenix’s city council approved a plan Wednesday night barring ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. That matters: public resources should not be made available to a system that deepens fear and insecurity for immigrant communities already facing unequal power. But this is only a boundary around city property, not accountability or due process. Protecting people requires more than limiting where enforcement can operate; it means confronting the structures that leave immigrants vulnerable in the first place.
